def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Each colored shape is a horizontal bar followed by a perpendicular/adjacent tail;
    # extend the tail row to the right edge in color 1 (demo: 2 becomes 1).
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    bg=min(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    fg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    # Locate sparse rows containing non-background, non-dominant foreground; extend rightward.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        cols=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,fg)]
        if cols:
            last=max(cols)
            # only fill contiguous background after the rightmost part of the object
            for c in range(last+1,w):
                out[r][c]=1
    return out

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # For rows containing the motif, convert trailing background cells to 1
    # after the last non-background cell; apply where it forms an incomplete row.
    bg=min(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        nz=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
        if nz and nz[-1] < w-1:
            # only extend row when it has a foreground run reaching into latter half
            if nz[-1] >= w//2:
                for c in range(nz[-1]+1,w): out[r][c]=1
    return out
PY
